retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.

selection.forbidden: All hit rates, other attack/defense extras, MAGIC, COUNTER, light/dark elements, and zero-weight alias records.

limitations: Historical IDs and technical labels are not current official artifact IDs or verified official names.
FIRE/WATER/TREE/SOIL are normalized to fire/water/wood/stone; LIGHT and DARK remain excluded because their rules require separate resolution.
Attribute-adding effects ID65 and ID85 are excluded; their extra behavior is not erased.
Zero-weight alias records such as ID314/324/332/333 are not included in this acquisition pool.
Weights come from the old emulator; its README warns the distribution may be inaccurate.
Current official-client compatibility has not been verified.
Existing legacy-neutral-v1 and legacy-miracles-v1 pools and fingerprints are unchanged.
